name: Delete browser extension configuration
description: Delete browser extension configuration Deletes the browser extension configuration for an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-extension/config
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-extension/config
Deletes the browser extension configuration for an account. The shard mapping is preserved and not deleted.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.

name: Update browser extension configuration
description: Update browser extension configuration Replaces the browser extension configuration for an account. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-extension/config
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-extension/config
Replaces the browser extension configuration for an account. The configuration must already exist. The shard mapping is immutable.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; body (body)

name: Get a single browser extension inventory
description: Get a single browser extension inventory Returns the installed extension inventory for a single registered browser extension device. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-extension/config/inventories/{registration_id}

name: List browser extension inventories
description: List browser extension inventories Returns the installed extension inventory for each registered browser extension device in the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-extension/config/inventories
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-extension/config/inventories
Returns the installed extension inventory for each registered browser extension device in the account. Each device reports its inventory periodically; this endpoint returns the latest known snapshot per device. Results are paginated by cursor. Pass the `cursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page. `per_page` controls page size (default 50, max 200).
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.
Optional: cursor (query) — Opaque cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.; per_page (query) — Number of results per page (default 50, max 200).
